messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)
Handed to the team · Return stuck at warehouse 12 days after delivery; only a person can push ShipBob

Darrell, I'm sorry about this. Your NerdOctaxe reached our Chattanooga dock on November 6. Twelve days later, the warehouse still hasn't checked it in. Your Thor P2 (Shop····) is still set aside for you, but it can't ship until they do. That's our mistake to fix, not yours.

I've sent it back to the team as urgent, along with your UPS proof of delivery. Someone will pick up your ticket and get back to you. You'll also get the Thor P2 tracking by email as soon as it ships.
Are there many orders like mine

I can't speak to other customers' orders. What I can tell you is that most returns get checked in within a few days of arriving. Yours sitting on the dock for 12 days isn't normal, and that's why I marked it urgent.

Nothing is wrong with your claim itself. The warranty is approved, the Thor P2 is set aside for you, and the only thing left is the warehouse logging your unit. Is there anything else on the order I can check for you?
